steps.content: The camp crouches near a fresh rift in the WhiteSands, where several merchant ships huddle around, disguised to mimic the ships of desert bandits. Energy usage throughout the camp appears strictly rationed; by now, only a couple tents still pulse with light.
Outside the camp, the sandstorm rages on. It is clear they are taking extreme precautions to remain unseen. Jasmine is carried into a tent that appears to serve as a makeshift infirmary.

People bustle about taking inventory of goods, struggling to communicate in the common tongue, their words tinged with various accents. Sibilla lingers outside the medical tent, carefully studying her surroundings.

steps.speaker: Caravan Member A
steps.content: Her condition is stable now, and she should wake up after some sleep. Don't worry.

steps.speaker: Caravan Member A
steps.content: She may look delicate, but that girl's surprisingly tough and recovers at a shocking speed. Those were the devils of WhiteSands, yet she held her own all by herself. I've never seen a warrior like her before.

steps.speaker: Caravan Member A
steps.content: Oh, right, you got dragged into the fight too. Let me check on you...
She reaches out to Sibilla, only for her to recoil, instinct overriding trust. After a moment of contemplation, Sibilla finally speaks, each word measured.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...Those weren't desert bandits who attacked us. Were they... soldiers from some proper army?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I've heard that DisCity has set up secure quarters for Outland caravans. Wouldn't you be safer if you relocated there?

steps.speaker: Caravan Member A
steps.content: Well... we asked DisCity officials, but they never gave straight answers. So honestly... I've got no clue where that troop came from. Those brutal bastards just keep attacking any Outlanders who get close to DisCity.
Before Sibilla can ask more questions, another voice cuts in—sharp, agitated.

steps.speaker: Caravan Member B
steps.content: Screw their "secure quarters"! Anyone with half a brain knows those are just pens DisCity set up to watch us. Who the hell would put up with that kind of insult?!

steps.speaker: Caravan Member B
steps.content: That patrol squad's obviously in on it with them! They gun down every Outlander in their sight without even a warning—yeah, I'm talking about those ************s we just fought!!
The man's temper burns quick and bright. After his angry outburst, he catches sight of Sibilla huddling in a defensive curl, his gaze sharpening with sudden suspicion.

steps.speaker: Caravan Member B
steps.content: Hey! What's the deal with that woman in surgery? I caught her accent. That's Disian through and through! You from DisCity? What's your tie to those mad dogs earlier? You two—Gah!
His knee suddenly gives way as though a force from behind has struck him, and his imposing figure, which has been looming over Sibilla, collapses instantly.
The gentle female warrior beside him speaks with a smile.

steps.speaker: Caravan Member A
steps.content: You've been talking a lot, dear. Feeling thirsty? Why don't you get yourself some water?

steps.speaker: Caravan Member B
steps.content: I didn't say anything wrong! These people just appeared out of nowhere. How do we know they're not enemy spies? Campbell said it himself—we can't afford traitors among us, or else—ouch!

steps.speaker: Caravan Member A
steps.content: You weren't actually asleep just now, were you? How did you miss that? That girl was in a total bloodlust, with her Mania completely off the rails. There's no way she's working with them. Now go get some water, seriously.
The tall man rubs the back of his knee and walks away grumbling. The female warrior then turns to Sibilla, her tone now more sincere.

steps.speaker: Caravan Member A
steps.content: I'm sorry about my brother. He's been on night watch these days and is really on edge—gets triggered whenever DisCity is mentioned. By the way, my name is Arienna, and my brother is Adriel.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: Well, you see, even at the official Great Expo quarters, we can hardly trust DisCity to provide solid protection. That's why we've split up our stuff and stashed some of it here.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: I'm sure you also know how it is. Everyone brings their most valuable resources all the way to the Great Expo, all to be exchanged for the Hypercubes to bring back home. We can't afford to have them robbed by bandits along the way.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: Heh, though trading with DisCity isn't much different from being robbed.
Sibilla completely understands. She starts hesitating whether to respond, and Arienna seems to see her right through.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: What about you? Which caravan are you from? Why are you traveling alone?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Well... I'm just a traveling merchant. I was captured by desert bandits on my way to DisCity and stuck with them for days. Jasmine was there even longer—they used her as a weapon. We managed to escape together.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: ...Ah, no wonder that girl's in such bad shape... In DisCity, even the bandits don't see us as people.
She falls silent for a while before speaking up again.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: She's got chains on her ankles. Looks tough on the outside, but she's covered in wounds. Must have been through some brutal stuff...

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: What's more concerning is how the Mania corruption messed with her head. Her mind's all over the place, and it's only getting worse. Good thing you got her out when you did—maybe there's still hope for her.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...I didn't do anything, really, and I barely know her. She's the one who's been protecting me this whole journey. We're just traveling together, that's all.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: You really put it all on the line back there to protect her during the fight just now. You're a brave and admirable comrade.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Comrade...?

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: Right. In the shadow of DisCity, all Outlanders are comrades. We understand each other better than anyone.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: We've got some Hypercubes in our camp. I'll use them to try and ease your friend's condition. Once the Campbell experts from Fraser get back, they can give her more targeted treatment.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: You should come with us. We have everything here—supplies, shelter, and Fraser's backing to keep us safe. When you return home, you can gather your people and bring them into the Farland Alliance. We really should stand together.
Before Arienna can say more, her brother returns carrying two cups.

steps.speaker: Adriel
steps.content: Look who's talking! You've been yapping nonstop while she barely gets a word out. Can't you see she's uncomfortable? I didn't bring enough water for you. Go grab your own!
As he speaks, Adriel presses one of the cups into Sibilla's hands. It's still warm.

steps.speaker: Adriel
steps.content: Go on, drink up! This is my hometown's special brew. Most guests don't even get to see it!

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...Thank you both.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: You're welcome. We're just happy to meet a fellow Outlander, especially in a place like this.
[Scene Change to Jasmine]
Night has fully descended. While the caravan members are busy preparing to relocate, Sibilla waits for the right moment when no one is watching and slips into the medical tent.
Jasmine is already awake, still clutching that pair of strange blades in her hands. When she sees Sibilla enter, her face lights up with an innocent, almost pet-like smile.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: You're awake. Are you feeling any better?

steps.speaker: ******* hell. I signed up for the pay, not a coffin. I'm not dying in this ****hole...
steps.content: I've been up for ages. Been listening to all the little secrets floating around this place.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: So that Great Expo is really hard to get into! Outsiders have to bring their most precious treasures as a tribute just to stand a chance. Isn't that just like those desert bandits demanding their cut?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...That's right.

Small city-states have no choice but to sell off their already-meager resources, population, technology, or even their very autonomy in return for a mere semblance of protection or aid from DisCity, or perhaps a scant offering of Hypercubes. Such is the true essence of today's Great Expo.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: So what's your plan now? You didn't bring anything valuable along. Can you still get into the Great Expo like this? Maybe sell something, or should I go get something for you?
Sibilla gives her a grin.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: It's not like I have nothing at all. It takes someone as down on their luck as me to pull out the sympathy card, you know.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: The sympathy card? Will anyone actually buy that?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Of course, I'm pretty good at spinning stories.
Jasmine's eyes dart about as she mentally chews over the words, processing their meaning. Once she has fully digested the idea, she gleefully grabs her "teacher's" hands.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Great! Just give me a moment to loosen up these rusty joints. Then we'll hit the road.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Oh, traveling with the people here is another option. They're Outlanders like you and are also heading to the Great Expo. Looks like they've already accepted you as one of their own.
Sibilla falls silent.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Jasmine, I've come to say goodbye.
Jasmine blinks, looking all confused.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Why? You'd die so easily on your own. That's why you need me to protect you, right?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Yes, but now you're the one who needs to be looked after.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: What's more concerning is how the Mania corruption messed with her head. Her mind's all over the place, and it's only getting worse.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: We've got some Hypercubes in our camp. I'll use them to try and ease your friend's condition. Once the Campbell experts from Fraser get back, they can give her more targeted treatment.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: The caravan people like you a lot, and they can give you proper treatment.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Right now, the most important thing is for you to heal properly. Stop pushing yourself to fight. It's too dangerous.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...You don't want me to go to the Great Expo, do you?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Are you scared after seeing what I just did? Afraid that I'll do the same thing at the Great Expo? That I'll kill people?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Are you trying to protect the people in DisCity? Or... you have a friend there? What kind of person are they?

Sibilla is beginning to understand Jasmine—the recent fight, her fractured memories, uncontrollable Mania, and the desperate rush to DisCity... She's seen too many like this in the Outlands: souls seething with hatred, arriving with vengeance in their hearts.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Jasmine... it's nothing like that...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Heh... Don't worry, I promise I won't hurt him. You're such a good person, Sibilla, and I'm sure so is your friend. I won't hurt either of you...
steps.female_content: Heh... Don't worry, I promise I won't hurt her. You're such a good person, Sibilla, and I'm sure so is your friend. I won't hurt either of you...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Good people are so rare these days. I hope you all live as long as possible.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: So, take me with you, will you? I'll be good. Just don't leave me all alone.
Sibilla lets out a sigh, shaking her head at Jasmine.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Stay here and rest up for now, Jasmine, so when we meet again, I can see a healthier, happier you.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Get well soon, and let's see each other again at the Great Expo. I can already picture you dancing on a grand stage.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Dance? Me?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Yeah, it's obvious just watching you. Your steps are so light, and even your fighting looks graceful—every spin, leap, and flip flows perfectly together. It's like watching the lead performer at a grand gala.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: You shouldn't bear all these scars. You were born to stand on gala stages, bathed in applause. That's who you really are.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Yeah, I... do feel something, if you say so.
Jasmine raises her hand—as if testing the weight of Sibilla's words—her scarred arms folding gently together.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: My body seems to remember those moves my mind forgot... When I swing my blades, even gunfire and explosions sound like familiar music and drum beats.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Who knows? Maybe I really used to not fight at all—just danced wild and free at some celebration instead.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Once they treat your condition, your memories will come back. Then we can meet up at the Great Expo. Maybe by then, you'll even have new friends by your side.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Alright then. Let's meet at the Great Expo, and do bring your friend to see my performance.
The two envelop each other in a warm embrace, their smiles oblivious to the world unfolding outside.
Until a violent impact strikes the side of the ship.

steps.speaker: Adriel
steps.content: Enemy! Enemy incoming!! Grab your weapons!! Those bastards from DisCity are back!!
Several hundred meters away...

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: ...As you said, we've tracked down the rabble's camp. There aren't many weapons hidden here. It's a stretch to say they're planning any real trouble.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: But their attitude says it all.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: How convenient. They've picked a blind spot where FAC can't see a thing. They can meet their end in silence right here.
This time, the artillery fire is real, sending violent tremors through the ship.
[Scene Change]
Sibilla has just steadied herself when another wave of dread washes over her.
Her traveling companion, barely settled back into calm, tenses again at the thunder of gunfire. Jasmine sits up, her gaze fixed beyond the tent as if pulled by some unseen force.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Heh, sorry, Sibilla. I just promised to behave, but fate's such a cruel jester. Now I have to fight again. Promises on the battlefield always shatter like glass. Forgive me, will you?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: But don't worry, those DisCity people are all bad. I know that stench all too well. So really, it's fine to kill them, right?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: You just focus on staying alive. That's all you need to do.

She peels away the bandages slowly, the sticky pull of blood and torn flesh registering not as pain, but as some sweet prize. Outside, the caravan warriors roar Jasmine's name, eager for her to join them in battle.
But to Sibilla's ears, it sounds like death's own encouragement—a call to sharpen Sibilla into a blade and hurl her body toward the grave.

This is all wrong. Goodbyes are supposed to lead to joyful reunions—not this. She decided to leave Jasmine behind to keep her safe, far from madness and bloodshed. She can't bear to see her lose herself to violence again. It's just all wrong! With a surge of desperation, Sibilla races after her...

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Jasmine! Your body hasn't recovered—
But she fails to catch Jasmine. As she bursts from the tent, her shoe catches on the gunwale. For one breathless moment, her balance wavers, then the world tilts...
It feels as if a hand pushes her from behind. Sibilla loses her balance and plunges headfirst into the swallowing sand. From deep within comes what sounds like the grinding jaws of sandworms.
...Whatever happens now, the battle is no longer her concern.
